info.name: FinTrack API - Complete Regression
info.description: Complete sequential regression flow for authentication, profile authorization, accounts, categories, transactions, balance effects, ownership, validation, conflicts, cleanup, and rate limiting. Run the collection in order against a freshly seeded environment.

exec: pm.test('JWT and user identity are returned', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.access_token.split('.')).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(body.user.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('registerEmail')); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('secondToken', body.access_token); pm.collectionVariables.set('secondUserId', body.user.id); }

pm.test('Owner and initial balance are correct', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('registeredUserId'))); pm.expect(body.balance).to.eql(250000); });

pm.test('List contains only the created owner account', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.some(a => a.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('accountId')))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.every(a => a.user_id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('registeredUserId')))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Other user cannot read my account

exec: pm.test('Updated name is returned', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Updated Postman User'));

item.name: Normal user cannot list all users

exec: pm.test('Admin can read user profile', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Other user cannot read my transaction

exec: pm.test('Created transactions are present', () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(t => t.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('incomeTransactionId'))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('expenseTransactionId'))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('transferTransactionId'))); });
pm.test('Relations are nested', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.account).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.category).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Source balance reflects income, expense, and transfer', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Referenced destination account cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test('Source balance returns to initial value', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().balance).to.eql(250000); });
pm.test('Destination balance returns to zero', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().balance).to.eql(0); });
